description: Search this server's tools by keyword and return matching names with one-line descriptions. Read-only, makes no Canvas calls and works before a token is set. Use it to find the right tool among the 200+ available.

group.description: Optional group: identity, courses, assignments, submissions, grades, quizzes, discussions, inbox, calendar, content, groups, rubrics, search, planner, planning or meta.

query.description: Keyword to look for in tool names and descriptions, e.g. "grade". Omit to list everything.

name: search_tools
title: Search Tools
